propositions: _blame_file_commits currently returns empty list both on git failure and on successful-but-empty blame, making failure indistinguishable from legitimately empty results

derive_caused_by tallies blame results across multiple paths, so partial failure (success on some paths, failure on others) causes it to compute majority vote over incomplete data and write incorrect caused_by links
git blame operations under blobless promisor fault blobs incrementally and can partially fail on every bug close without explicit --caused-by flag
clone guidance must document --filter=blob:none (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s vs full 1.04 GiB / 59 s) and warn against --filter=tree:0 (3.57 GiB, 3.4x larger)
_blame_file_commits must return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty to enable derive_caused_by to abort on any per-path failure
derive_caused_by must abort and return None when any path yields None from _blame_file_commits, while treating legitimately empty files as success
